albums.body:
Flowers of My Mediterranean Garden

June 5, 2017

On the occasion of #WorldEnvironmentDay 2017 I am posting flowers of my Mediterranean garden in Montenegro. Nature is not my environment – it is embedded in me and significant part of my professional career I spent in efforts to protect the nature. Whenever I am visiting my garden I’m reconnecting with nature and celebrating this places that matter to me. I hope you will enjoy browsing these photos. Get connect and pay quick visit if you are passing by.

Interested in those places? Get in touch with me today.

albums.body:
This gallery brings together photographs from conferences, workshops and fieldwork organised within WATER SUM — Sustainable Use of Transboundary Water Resources and Water Security Management. The project supported cooperation on water challenges in the Middle East and North Africa, focusing on Tunisia, Egypt and Jordan.

The photographs capture opportunities for dialogue, shared learning and practical engagement with water management challenges. These activities connected institutions, experts and local stakeholders around integrated water resources management, climate adaptation and community water security.

Implemented by the Regional Environmental Center for Central and Eastern Europe (REC) with funding from Sweden through Sida, WATER SUM combined regional knowledge exchange with local action planning. As Project Director, I oversaw implementation quality and supported coordination among the project team, beneficiaries and donor.

albums.body:
This gallery brings together photographs from conferences, workshops and fieldwork within TOUR — TOURists friends of the environment. The project connected partners and stakeholders from Italy, Albania and Montenegro to advance environmentally responsible tourism in the South Adriatic.

From discussions with tourism operators and local communities to visits exploring natural landscapes and conservation practices, these activities created opportunities to exchange experience and develop practical approaches to ecotourism. They supported a shared vision linking environmental protection, cultural heritage and local economic opportunities.

As Tourism and Conservation Specialist, contracted by the Tourism Organisation of Kotor, I supported workshops, business exchanges and conference preparation in Montenegro, helping connect tourism development with the conservation of natural landscapes.
